# Smoking

> Smoking is a free field guide to places where smoking is allowed: smoke shops, terraces, courtyards, lookouts, kiosks and benches, with a live map, photos and reviews from adults who use them. For adults at or above the legal smoking age where they live (18+ gate).

- Live map of smoke-friendly terraces, courtyards, kiosks and smoke shops near you.
- Listings come from open map data and are verified, with photos and reviews from the community.
- Anyone can suggest a spot, add a photo or leave a review.
- Works in several languages, in light or dark mode.
- Smoking does not sell tobacco, nicotine or cannabis products.

## Pages
- https://smoking.6x7.gr/: About the guide (public)
- https://smoking.6x7.gr/place/: Individual place pages (public)
- https://smoking.6x7.gr/privacy: Privacy
- https://smoking.6x7.gr/terms: Terms
